items.change: ExhibitDialog onClose returns when the dialog is open again: the queued 'close' event of an earlier close no longer closes a story reopened before it landed. keyboard.spec drops the wait for the close event.
items.evidence: Probe on the built site: close the verafin story and click its opener in the same task the dialog closes. Old build: the story ends closed at '/'. New build: open at /exhibit/verafin/. keyboard.spec and dialog.spec pass on desktop and pixel7 without the wait.

items.change: loadExhibit resolves to { error } instead of rejecting; LoadedExhibit hands the error to the frame (LoadFailed), which keeps the placeholder crate. The preload no longer needs a catch. The pageerror acknowledgement in exhibits.spec is removed.
items.evidence: Root cause: R3F's createRoot passes reportError as onCaughtError, so any error caught by the exhibit's boundary inside the canvas also fires a window error (the 'pageerror'). Reproduced by removing the acknowledgement (guards tripped with 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module'); after the fix exhibits.spec passes on pixel7 with only the console acknowledgements.

items.change: The debug chunk renders r3f-perf's PerfHeadless with a plain DOM readout (fps, GPU and CPU ms, calls, triangles, programs; bottom-left, fixed) instead of <Perf>, whose WebGL texts load a bundled data: woff through drei's preloadFont. Production CSP unchanged. ARCHITECTURE line on r3f-perf updated. New quality.spec (k) loads ?debug under the global guards (desktop).
items.evidence: quality (k) failed before the fix with 'Refused to connect to data:font/woff... connect-src self' and passes after. A first attempt (patching troika Text.sync to swap the font) could not reach preloadFont, so it was dropped. Debug chunk 112.5 KB to 86.5 KB (reported, not budgeted).
